note: Combat model (M9, docs/FLEETS.md). Battles between fast fleets last seconds or less; everything is decided by the plans set in advance. Times in seconds, ranges in light-seconds, speeds in fractions of c.

braked.note: closing speed when an attacker brakes into a system (a slow, long battle)

station.note: planetary defences: hp 20 + 6 per power of ten of population above a thousand

strike.note: a relativistic impact kills this fraction of the people (larger peoples on a world lose less than all); an alerted system with point defences or debris screens may intercept it

atrocity.note: when the light of a world's destruction reaches a colony: the attacker's own colonies lose loyalty (shame), other empires' colonies a little (fear), and their capitals hold a grievance against the attacker

heatNote: beams and guns can fire at most this many seconds in one engagement (heat)

bombardment.note: an attacker that brakes in and wins bombards the colony: this fraction dies, and its loyalty to its own empire falls
